mapper.select: SELECT id, title, content, color, folder_id, updated_at, deleted FROM mf_note WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1000
SELECT id, title, content, color, folder_id, updated_at, deleted FROM mf_note WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM mf_note WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND folder_id = #{folderId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mf_note (user_id, folder_id, title, content, color) VALUES (#{entity.userId}, #{entity.folderId}, #{entity.title}, #{entity.content}, #{entity.color})
mapper.update: UPDATE mf_note SET title = #{entity.title}, content = #{entity.content}, color = #{entity.color}, folder_id = #{entity.folderId}, deleted = #{entity.deleted}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{entity.userId} AND id = #{entity.id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM mf_note WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{id}
DELETE FROM mf_note WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND folder_id = #{folderId}
